scope: The named credits_check failure only. No claim of final rerender, whole-film visual or audio QA, or release approval.
root_cause: The old two-frame whole-frame YAVG threshold treated the bright decorative notebook below the credit text as a missing card. The text remained complete and high contrast. A whole-frame brightness average did not measure whether the credit body was visible.

visual_review.observations: Both actual decoded full-resolution frames visibly contain the site, SOURCES heading, all three source domains, full Life of Riley / Kevin MacLeod / incompetech.com attribution and CC BY 4.0 licence. Text is complete, clear and unobscured. The notebook begins below about y=1390, well beneath the last licence line.

repair: Keep source derivation, verbatim music-credit equality, CC BY attribution, safe-width and phone-size floors, engine presence, configured 12.3-second sign-off and ten-second readable minimum.
Resolve the actual EndCredits full-opacity interval and reject short, unresolved or truncated timelines; require a delivered master.

Decode 21 frames spaced half a second across the full ten-second interval. Measure every site/source/music body row independently of logo and notebook. Each must retain background median below 30 and at least 0.5 percent pixels brighter than 200.

Recognize rendered credit pixels at the start, midpoint and end using local OCR without expected strings supplied to the recognizer. Require all actual source, site and full music/licence strings, plus SOURCES. Normalize typography only; no fuzzy matching.
Fail on absent master, failed frame decode, missing OCR backend, malformed OCR output, missing text or a changing master. Bind evidence to actual video, renderer and credit/timeline hashes.
Correct static fit measurement to use the actual split music lines, rendered font sizes and letter spacing.

actual_result.ocr_backend: macOS Vision accurate, language correction off

coverage: truncated duration and short/unsupported opacity timeline
missing source or licence row despite bright props

limitations: This bounded check samples contrast every half second and OCR at three points; it does not exhaustively inspect every video frame or independently guarantee human readability on every display.
OCR must be available locally: macOS Vision through Swift or Tesseract. Missing or unrecognizable output fails closed and may require investigation.
The credit row adapter and timeline parser deliberately match the current 1080x1920 EndCredits design. A layout or timeline change requires adapter review; unsupported timelines fail.
Current evidence binds candidate 2 only. Run the checker again against the next rendered master; root retains responsibility for complete preflight and visual QA.
